result_semantic_payload.summary: No evidence of fraud-related financial activity was found. The 'windows' source scope contains exactly 3 files (all small plaintext, all present/not deleted, no LLM summaries attached): /notes.txt (185 B), /expense_policy.txt (165 B) and /docs/travel_reimbursement_form.txt (166 B). Their full contents were read and none contains a transaction, payment, receipt, bank/card/account detail, invoice, or any indication of fraudulent conduct. The one document that touches money, /notes.txt, explicitly states 'No financial transactions were discussed.' The reimbursement form is a blank template that self-declares 'This is a blank template. No personal data.' The policy file states only procedural rules (submit receipts within 30 days; manager approval above 5000 CNY; payments processed every Friday) with no submissions or approvals recorded. The only timeline events are three FILE_CREATED events (t=1790556664 for notes.txt and expense_policy.txt, t=1790556673 for the form) — no account usage, execution, prefetch/amcache, registry, persistence, browser, network or event-log activity of any kind. Therefore: (a) it is supportable to say no fraud-related financial activity appears in the analyzed content; (b) it is NOT supportable to say the device/user is free of fraud, because the capture is a 3-file text subset, not a real Windows forensic image — task metadata reports platforms=[] and source_scopes=[], and there is no registry, event log, prefetch, amcache, shellbags, browser history, network or account data available to corroborate or refute financial conduct. Absence of evidence here is absence of coverage, not evidence of absence.

The three financial-adjacent documents are administrative/procedural artifacts rather than records of actual financial activity: a department meeting note, a blank reimbursement template, and an expense policy stating procedural rules only.

The source scope is a minimal 3-file plaintext subset and not a genuine Windows forensic image; task metadata reports platforms=[] and source_scopes=[], and no registry, event-log, prefetch, amcache, browser, network or account evidence is present, so the scope cannot corroborate or refute real-world financial conduct.
It cannot be concluded that the device or its users are free of fraud; the negative finding is limited to the analyzed content and reflects absence of coverage rather than evidence of absence.
limitations: Limited to the 3 enumerated files; no negative-space evidence exists in the capture.
